title: Adding one simplex to a simplicial set is a pushout along the boundary of the standard simplex
statement: Let $U\subseteq V$ be a simplicial subset of a simplicial set [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set]. For $n\geq0$ let $\Delta[n]$ be the simplicial set with $\Delta[n]_m$ the set of order-preserving maps $\varphi:[m]\to[n]$ and $\Delta[n](\psi)(\varphi)=\varphi\circ\psi$, and let $\partial\Delta[n]\subseteq\Delta[n]$ be the simplicial subset whose $m$-simplices are the non-surjective $\varphi:[m]\to[n]$ (so $\partial\Delta[0]$ is empty). Suppose $n\geq0$ and $x\in V_n$ with $x\notin U_n$ satisfy (1) $V_i=U_i$ for $i<n$, (2) $V_n=U_n\cup\{x\}$, and (3) every $z\in V_j$ with $j>n$ and $z\notin U_j$ is degenerate. Let $a:\Delta[n]\to V$ be the morphism of simplicial sets $a(\varphi)=V(\varphi)(x)$ for $\varphi\in\Delta[n]_m$. Then $a(\partial\Delta[n]_m)\subseteq U_m$ for every $m$, and, writing $b:\partial\Delta[n]\to U$ for the restriction of $a$, the commutative square formed by $b$, $a$ and the inclusions $\partial\Delta[n]\subseteq\Delta[n]$, $U\subseteq V$ is a pushout square of simplicial sets: for every simplicial set $Y$ and morphisms $g:U\to Y$, $h:\Delta[n]\to Y$ with $g\circ b=h|_{\partial\Delta[n]}$ there is a unique morphism $f:V\to Y$ with $f|_U=g$ and $f\circ a=h$. (For $n=0$ the compatibility condition is empty, so $V$ with the inclusion of $U$ and $a$ is a coproduct $U\amalg\Delta[0]$.)

proof.text: Let a be the Yoneda morphism of x. First x is nondegenerate: an expression from degree r < n would have its ancestor in U by hbelow, hence x in U. The subcomplex B = a^{-1}(U) of the standard simplex contains the boundary: by SSet.Subcomplex.le_iff_contains_nonDegenerate it suffices to check its nondegenerate simplices, which have degree less than n by SSet.dim_lt_of_nonDegenerate and the dimension bound for the boundary. Their images lie in U by hbelow. B is proper since the identity simplex maps to x, which is outside U. SSet.stdSimplex.eq_boundary_iff therefore gives B = boundary Delta[n]. Restrict a using Subcomplex.lift to obtain b; cancel the monomorphism V -> X to prove the required commutativity.

proof.text: For a simplex z of V outside U, apply [lem-weil-pbc-simplicial-set-nondegenerate-decomposition] to write z = V(f)(y) with y nondegenerate. The ancestor y lies outside U by stability under V(f). Its degree r cannot be less than n by hbelow and cannot be greater than n by habove and nondegeneracy. Thus r = n, and hat identifies y with x. Consequently the inclusion U -> V and the map a are jointly surjective in every degree.

proof.text: In each degree the commutative square is a pullback of sets: an image a(p) lies in U precisely when p belongs to the boundary, by step 1; the boundary inclusion is injective. Off the boundary, a simplex of Delta[n] corresponds to an epimorphism f into [n], since it is a surjective order-preserving map. If a(f) = a(g), uniqueness of the map in [lem-weil-pbc-simplicial-set-nondegenerate-decomposition], applied to the nondegenerate simplex x, implies f = g. Thus a is injective on the complement of the boundary.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib CategoryTheory.Limits.Types.isPushout_of_isPullback_of_mono' in each degree to the pullback of step 3, the jointly surjective maps of step 2, and the injectivity off the boundary of step 3. CategoryTheory.IsPushout.of_forall_isPushout_app upgrades these degreewise pushouts to a pushout of simplicial sets. This works also for n = 0: the boundary dimension bound has no nondegenerate generators, so the first step treats its empty boundary without a separate case.
